meta.title: Kolhapur floods — July 2021 (replay)
meta.labelling: Rainfall is historical ERA5-Land reanalysis with its ORIGINAL timestamps. Every ground report and road event in this file is a SYNTHETIC SCENARIO input written by the team to exercise the system; none is a real record unless it has origin "documented" and a citation.
notes: Places and roads are referenced by name and resolved against OpenStreetMap at load time; no coordinates are invented.
Reports are extracted with the deterministic keyword extractor so every replay run is identical.
No river-level observations are included until a cited timeseries is added (the UI shows this as a data gap).

reports.text: River water is rising near the temple, water on the road to the village.
पाणी घरात शिरलं आहे, शाळेजवळचा मुख्य रस्ता बंद आहे.
Water has entered houses near the school, vehicles cannot pass.
12 people trapped on the roof, elderly and children, please send a boat.
लोक छतावर अडकले आहेत, बोट पाठवा. पाणी वाढत आहे.
Highway road is flooded near the bridge, trucks cannot pass.
Bridge is under water, traffic stopped on the highway.
Road is open here, no flooding in our lane.
Water has receded from the main road, road is open now.
पाणी ओसरलं, रस्ता सुरू झाला आहे.
